description: This file defines the `A2AClient` class, which provides a wrapper interface for interacting with an A2A (agent-to-agent) system. The class offers methods to initialize an internal client, fetch an agent card, send messages, and send streaming messages to an agent, with lazy initialization of the underlying client.

classes.name: A2AClient
classes.description: Provides a class-based interface for A2A agent invocation, with lazy client initialization and methods for communicating with A2A agents.

methods.name: __init__( self, base_url: str, timeout: float = 60.0, extra_headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the A2AClient wrapper with base URL, optional timeout, and extra headers.

methods.name: "A2AClientType" _get_client(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates the underlying A2A client.

methods.name: "AgentCard" get_agent_card(self)
methods.description: Fetches the agent card information from the server.

methods.name: LiteLLMSendMessageResponse send_message( self, request: "SendMessageRequest" )
methods.description: Sends a message request to the A2A agent and returns the response.

methods.name: AsyncIterator["SendStreamingMessageResponse"] send_message_streaming( self, request: "SendStreamingMessageRequest" )
methods.description: Sends a streaming message request and yields streaming responses asynchronously.
